identity.name: Yi-6B
identity.summary: Yi-6B is one of the first two bilingual English/Chinese base models released in the Yi series, with 6B parameters.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only architecture, parameter count, and bilingual base-model status; no training-data details, evaluation results, or design/development process are documented.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card states training data only as 'bilingual English/Chinese base models' with no dataset composition, collection, curation, or filtering details.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight bilingual base model with no stated data sources or traceability for the English/Chinese training data.

possible_risks.description: The content of the training data used for generating the model's output is not accessible.
possible_risks.justification: Base text-generation model with no documentation of training-data content, so outputs cannot be traced back to specific sources.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card lists only 'text-generation' as the primary task and gives no intended-use or misuse guidance for this open-weight base model.

specifications.model_size: 11.3 GiB of safetensors weights (12,122,104,832 bytes) in BF16

training_context.training_data: The 6B model is one of two bilingual English/Chinese base models in the first public release.
